Here’s a clearer, more professional rephrasing of your text:

"The RH archiving change (story 2323911) caused active trades that were not archived in CMRS to be reported to TRAX as ‘REPL’ instead of ‘NEWM’. This is impacting the #13 fix. The new ESP extract for #13 is sending replay messages for rebooked trades that have been updated with original Position Trader information via OMS trade linkages. Because these messages are marked as replay (<SST_REPLAY> = ‘Y’), RH reports them to TRAX as ‘REPL’. TRAX will reject all #13 replay messages because they were never previously reported. In short, the #13 replay messages will be treated like routine BAU replay messages and rejected, which renders the #13 changes from ESP and RH ineffective."
